groundnut leaf spot.cause: Fungi (Cercospora arachidicola causes early leaf spot, Phaeoisariopsis personata causes late leaf spot)
groundnut leaf spot.symptoms: Early leaf spot: roundish light to dark brown spots, often with a clear yellow ring, showing from about a month after sowing. Late leaf spot: darker, nearly black spots, mostly on the underside of the leaf and usually without a strong yellow ring, showing later in the crop. In bad attacks leaves turn yellow and drop, and the pods are smaller.
look_alikes: Groundnut rust (orange-brown powdery pustules under the leaf)
Nutrient deficiency (for example magnesium or zinc) or ageing of lower leaves
groundnut leaf spot.favourable_weather: Warm, humid or rainy weather with dew or long leaf wetness. Late leaf spot often builds up as the crop gets older.

weather_profile.note: Warm and humid weather. No verified numbers loaded yet. Add them from ICRISAT or JAU.

organic_control: Remove and destroy badly affected plants and crop debris after harvest
Keep weeds under control, because heavy weed growth can help the disease
Avoid growing groundnut in the same field year after year
Aqueous neem leaf extract is reported as a low-cost option in some university material. Ask your KVK how and when to use it
groundnut leaf spot.chemical_control: Use only a product that is registered in India for groundnut and this disease. Seed treatment and foliar sprays are used in practice, so ask your agriculture officer or JAU for the product, dose and schedule. No product or dose is given here.
prevention: Use healthy seed and varieties recommended for your area
Rotate with a non-host crop such as a cereal
Plough in or remove crop residue after harvest
Scout from about a month after sowing, because spots start early
groundnut leaf spot.when_to_call_expert: If many leaves are spotted and dropping, especially before pod filling, because losses can be heavy.

groundnut rust.symptoms: Small orange-brown, powdery pustules, mostly on the underside of leaves, which can join up. Leaves dry out and drop early. It often appears together with late leaf spot, and a bad attack can cut yield heavily.
look_alikes: Early and late leaf spot (spots, not powdery pustules)
groundnut rust.favourable_weather: Moderate temperatures with high humidity and prolonged leaf wetness. The spores travel by wind.

weather_profile.note: About 20 to 25 C with humidity above about 85 percent, from a teaching source. Confirm with ICAR-DGR.

organic_control: Remove and destroy badly affected plants and volunteer groundnut plants
Keep the field free of weeds and crop residue
Aqueous neem leaf extract is reported in some university material for rust. Ask your KVK how and when to use it
groundnut rust.chemical_control: Use only a product that is registered in India for groundnut and this disease. Ask your agriculture officer or JAU for the product, dose and schedule. No product or dose is given here.
prevention: Use varieties recommended for your area
Scout the underside of leaves as the crop grows older
groundnut rust.when_to_call_expert: If orange pustules appear on many plants, because it can spread quickly by wind.
